_meta.description: Premium tier. Overrides the tier.accent token (allowing tenant-customisable accent) and the shadow.elevated token (richer floating-surface treatment). Apps that reference tier.accent and shadow.elevated automatically pick up the Enterprise treatment when [data-tier=enterprise] is set on root. Components that should NEVER differentiate by tier must reference color.brand.* and shadow.lg directly instead.

accent.comment: Enterprise default accent - deeper teal than brand.sky. Tenants on white-label plans may override at runtime via CSS variable injection on the data-tier element.

elevated.comment: Enterprise floating-surface shadow - deeper, slightly cooler-tinted via ink-channel rgb.
